name: ZAR vs Gold: Commodity Story or Political Reset?
description: Compares inverted ZAR (1/USDZAR, so positive = ZAR appreciation) vs gold (GLD) cumulative returns since the Sep 2024 Fed cutting cycle. Investigates whether ZAR's rally is commodity-driven or a political reset story. Shows cumulative return comparison, rolling 20d return correlation, and summary statistics including total return, max drawdown, and mean 60d correlation.
source:
# ZAR vs Gold: Commodity Story or Political Reset?
# Compares inverted USDZAR (ZAR appreciation = positive) vs GLD cumulative returns
# since the Sep 2024 Fed cutting cycle start.

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

# USDZAR FX pair (primary asset)
src_fx = market_data_source()()
close_usdzar = src_fx.c

# Invert USDZAR so ZAR appreciation = positive return
close_zar = 1.0 / close_usdzar

# Gold via GLD ETF (reference)
gld = reference_stocks(ticker='GLD')()
close_gold = gld.c

# Timestamps for x-axis
ts = index().value

# ============================================================================
# DAILY RETURNS
# ============================================================================

ret_zar = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(close_zar)
ret_gold = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(close_gold)

# ============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE RETURNS (rebased to 0 at start)
# Product of (1 + daily_return) - 1
# ============================================================================

cum_zar = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1.0 + ret_zar) - 1.0
cum_gold = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1.0 + ret_gold) - 1.0

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING CORRELATION (20-day, on daily returns)
# ============================================================================

corr_20d = rolling_corr(window=20, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_zar, y=ret_gold)

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING 60-DAY CORRELATION (for summary stat)
# ============================================================================

corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_zar, y=ret_gold)

# ============================================================================
# MAX DRAWDOWN CALCULATIONS
# ============================================================================

# ZAR drawdown: peak cumulative return minus current
peak_zar = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(1.0 + cum_zar)
dd_zar = (1.0 + cum_zar) / peak_zar - 1.0
max_dd_zar = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(dd_zar)

# Gold drawdown: peak cumulative return minus current
peak_gold = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(1.0 + cum_gold)
dd_gold = (1.0 + cum_gold) / peak_gold - 1.0
max_dd_gold = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(dd_gold)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 1: Cumulative Returns Comparison (both series, one chart)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='ZAR vs Gold: Cumulative Return Since Sep 2024 Fed Cut',
    category='1. Cumulative Returns',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZAR (inverted USDZAR)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Gold (GLD)', color=Color.Gold)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Baseline')
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(cum_zar, cum_gold))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 2: Rolling 20-Day Return Correlation
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='ZAR-Gold Rolling 20d Return Correlation',
    category='2. Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d Rolling Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(corr_20d,))

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE: Key Statistics
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZAR vs Gold Summary',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['ZAR (inverted)', 'Gold (GLD)'],
        col_headers=['Total Return', 'Max Drawdown', 'Mean 60d Corr'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='3. Summary',
    order=2
)(cum_zar, max_dd_zar, corr_60d, cum_gold, max_dd_gold, corr_60d)
